doc: The scene the shipped game boots: data/maps/starter.tmx, one hero, one event script. Today a scene document is read for its `vars` block and nothing else -- there is no scene manager -- so the eight further keys docs/PLAN_SCENES.md 3.2 mints (loadouts, maps, entry_map, controls, routes, on_enter, on_exit, next) are deliberately absent and are REFUSED by the reader. Each lands in the same change as the code that reads it.
title: Starter

greeted.doc: Whether the starter script has already introduced itself once this session. Its two values are the two arms of the script's `if`, so both are reachable by pressing the action key twice.
